title: Existence, uniqueness, mass bound and support of the product [[0,1]]×X of a finite-mass current (supplied steps 5–6)
statement: For all m, k ∈ ℕ and every X ∈ D_k(ℝ^m) with M(X) < ∞ there is Z ∈ D_{k+1}(ℝ^{m+1}) such that: (a) ProdChar(X, Z), i.e. Z(η) = ∫_0^1 X(φ(s)) ds for every η ∈ D^{k+1}(ℝ^{m+1}) and every φ : ℝ → D^k(ℝ^m) with φ(s)(x)(v) = η(cons(s,x))(Fin.cons e₀ (fun i => ι(v i))) for all s ∈ [0,1], x ∈ ℝ^m, v : Fin k → ℝ^m; (b) every Z′ ∈ D_{k+1}(ℝ^{m+1}) with ProdChar(X, Z′) equals Z; (c) M(Z) ≤ M(X); (d) spt Z ⊆ {y ∈ ℝ^{m+1} : t(y) ∈ [0,1], tl(y) ∈ spt X}, where t(y) := EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m+1)) ℝ y 0 and tl(y) := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m+1)) ℝ y)). Here D^q = TestFormOn univ q, D_q = GeometricCurrentOn univ q, M = mass, spt = support, cons, ι, e₀ as above.
lean_statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k), X.mass < ∞ → ∃ Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (k + 1), (∀ (η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (k + 1)) (φ : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k), (∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ (x : Eucl m) (v : Fin k → Eucl m), (φ s : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) k) x v = (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (k + 1)) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) → Z η = ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, X (φ s)) ∧ (∀ Z' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (k + 1), (∀ (η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (k + 1)) (φ : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k), (∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ (x : Eucl m) (v : Fin k → Eucl m), (φ s : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) k) x v = (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (k + 1)) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) → Z' η = ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, X (φ s)) → Z' = Z) ∧ Z.mass ≤ X.mass ∧ Z.support ⊆ {y : Eucl (m + 1) | EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ y 0 ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ y)) ∈ X.support}
